history.headline: Grumpy Walrus was busy 10:20-10:47 PM ET. Net ADA about +1.8k; stake key holds ~3.47k ADA. STRIKE untouched. HOWDY pool ADA side fell 9,236 to 6,860, crossing its 7k kill line (the whale didn't sell HOWDY). swarm_learning.data_gap: Since mid-afternoon Oct 19 most Solada curve buys settle through an order escrow (deposit, then a fill from the curve address), so newer launches (QUIN, QNLGS, KRAK, WOLF) show entry and exit times but not buy costs. Their PnL is not computed.
swarm_learning.copy_trade_note: Research only, nothing built. A copier sees a swarm buy a block or more late and pays a higher curve price. The edge sits in the first ~15 minutes and in the sell timing, so a paper copy test would need per-block entry prices first.

history.headline: No tickets in either book. DEXY is the best shape on Solada: on-chain holders 69 -> 72, h1 buy-led (+19%) and a first real-voice thesis from @ErgoMinnow, but 14.2k ADA side and 72 holders keep it L2 under rule k. SER's largest holder outside the pool is now Grumpy Walrus (~9.4%, ~893 ADA of 71-ADA clips since 4:51 PM, rule s). BOLT sits 0.3% above its 400k kill line. Swarm study: swarm round trips entered within 15 minutes won 25 of 28 times (median hold 19 min); later entries won 7 of 18 (new rule x). QUIN and QNLGS were swarm round trips back to ~0% curve.

swarm_learning.data_gap: Since mid-afternoon Oct 19 most Solada curve buys settle through an order escrow (deposit, then a fill from the curve address), so newer launches (QUIN, QNLGS, KRAK, WOLF) show entry and exit times but not buy costs. Their PnL is not computed.
swarm_learning.copy_trade_note: Research only, nothing built. A copier sees a swarm buy a block or more late and pays a higher curve price. The edge sits in the first ~15 minutes and in the sell timing, so a paper copy test would need per-block entry prices first.

history.headline: MISS bonded on pump.fun at ~3:20 PM, Solada's second Solana-side bond, but Solana-native holders fell 38 to 29 within half an hour and the first post-bond hour was sell-led, so it stays L2 under rules n, q and new rule w. DEXY rebounded to 100.7k ADA (h1 +51%) while four swarm keys exited; still L2 under rules k and v. No tickets open or opened in either book. The Grumpy Walrus routed 1.0M SOLADA through a linked wallet for ~2.45k ADA and put 1k ADA into DEXY.

levels.DEXY: L2, closest to high-conviction on Solada (rules k, p, v): pool mcap 100.7k ADA (~C$30.8k), pool ADA side 14.9k, 71 on-chain holders (survived the 2 PM fade at 69), top-10 43.2%. GT h1 +51% on 26 buys / 15 sells; 3 PM hour ~14.8k ADA. Swarm keys holding fell 7 -> 3 (Lumpy Otter, Fancy Capybara, Moody Raccoon remain; Wacky Badger, Jumpy Vulture, Salty Sloth, Perky Seal exited). Grumpy Walrus added ~1.7k ADA. Fails rule k (120+ holders, 25k ADA side) and is 2.6h past graduation (rule v).

HIVE graduated at 1:58 PM onto a 9.6k ADA pool (L2). RAIN kept dumping after its paper close (5.5k ADA, 44 holders). No Solada or Pump.fun tickets open or opened. The Grumpy Walrus sold 1.56M BOLT and bought ~1.3k ADA of DEXY.

levels.DEXY: L2 (rules k, p, v): graduated 1:20 PM. Already slipping by 2:05 PM: pool mcap 88.8k ADA, ADA side 14.3k, 69 holders. At 1:55 PM, ~1.9h after launch. On-chain pool mcap 112.3k ADA (~C$34.3k), pool ADA side 16.0k, 71 on-chain holders, top-10 42.1%, top-1 10.4% (team says 10% is locked for a year). 1 PM hour ~55.3k ADA with 85 buys / 63 sells, price h1 +38%. Seven swarm keys hold (Lumpy Otter, Wacky Badger, Jumpy Vulture, Fancy Capybara, Moody Raccoon, Salty Sloth, Perky Seal) and the sweep wallet outside wallet bought in the first block. Same shape as RAIN two hours after graduating.
levels.BOLT: L2 (rules h, l): on-chain pool mcap 459.5k ADA (~C$140k), pool ADA side 31.4k, 273 on-chain holders (272 at 1:07), h1 +13.6% on 10 buys / 5 sells. Holders flat; Grumpy Walrus sold 1.56M BOLT into this bounce at 1:40 PM.

levels.HIVE: L2 (rules g, v): graduated to Minswap at 1:58 PM after 4 days on the curve. Pool mcap 42.8k ADA (~C$13k), pool ADA side 9.6k, 69 on-chain / 83 Solada holders, top-10 38.8%, no swarm key holding. Holders locked ~2% of supply after graduation (two ~10M locks to Nov 19). history.notes: Post-grad pools are swinging hard on a handful of wallets. FEED went 30k -> 55k ADA (+83%) with holders only 64 -> 68, while HERO went the other way, 19.1k -> 13.5k with holders 60 -> 48, tripping its kill line. IAGONAUT is the morning's real mover: launched 8:12, KOTH 8:18, graduated 8:57 AM ET, and is the first fast graduate this week still trading above the 50k cap after its pool opened (~57.7k pool-implied mcap, 11.5k ADA pool, 69 holders). Its first-block sniper group partly sold (Giggly Wombat and Wiggly Beaver out; ~16% -> ~7% across the rest), and Perky Seal, which also sniped FONE, is now the top holder at ~4.9%. Only 80 minutes post-grad, so it stays Tiny lottery with tight kill lines. X temperature: @soladafun tagged @IOHK_Charles ('remember this?') and drew a reply pile of small accounts; no Charles reply. BOLT's team announced a Strike copy-trading bot with $10k demo money for 1M+ BOLT wallets, and price rose 12% while holders fell 3. @chefrecklessdj is tying HERO to SONG, which SONG's own account disputes. CORE slipped under 80% KOTH progress (kill). @cryptodramz quiet; his teased drop still hasn't appeared.
